professionalSummary: Proven track record of implementing architecture that works beyond the engagement: systems that survive ownership changes, platforms that junior developers can maintain, and pipelines that don't require the original architect to debug. Three engagement models: embedded principal engineer for organizations without a functioning data team; greenfield or turnaround platform architecture and implementation; and retained fractional architect post-build.

keyAchievement.title: Flagship Long-Term Impact
keyAchievement.description: In 2012, architected a sample tracking and regulatory reporting system for AMPAC on Microsoft Azure—then still an early-stage platform. Thirteen years later, through multiple subsequent divestitures and ownership changes, that organization is still running and has credited the Azure decision with their ability to maintain operational independence. That engagement remains active.

skills: AI as execution layer for architecture-driven delivery
